traditional: 用 A 角度去講 B
jyutping: jung6 A gok3 dou6 heoi3 gong2 B

english.note: Use this when presenting or arguing about B from viewpoint A.

examples.english: We angle our discussion of this policy from an environmental perspective, so everyone will accept it more easily.
examples.traditional: 我哋用環保角度去講呢個政策，大家會易啲接受。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 jung6 waan4 bou2 gok3 dou6 heoi3 gong2 ni1 go3 zing3 caak3 daai6 gaa1 wui5 ji6 di1 zip3 sau6
